about.description: We are a locally owned, general dentistry practice providing a comprehensive list of services for the entire family. We strive to offer our community a unique dental experience using lasers and the latest technological advancements available to us today. Our primary goal is to learn new and effective ways to perform traditional dental procedures and educate our patients to save time and have an overall more comfortable experience.

new-patients.title: Welcome to Tennessee Center for Laser Dentistry
new-patients.lede: We're so glad you're here. Whether you're new to the area, ready for a fresh start, or simply looking for a more comfortable dental experience, our team is here to make your first visit smooth, relaxed, and personalized.

sections.title: What to expect at your first visit
sections.body:
Your first appointment is designed to be both thorough and comfortable. We take time to get to know you, understand your goals, and evaluate your oral health with advanced technology that allows for a more precise and gentle experience.

**Your visit typically includes:**

- A warm welcome and guided check-in
- Digital imaging and a comprehensive exam
- A gentle cleaning (when appropriate)
- Time with your doctor to review findings and ask questions
- A personalized treatment plan designed around your needs

You'll leave with a clear picture of your oral health — and a team committed to supporting you at every step.

sections.title: Your comfort matters
sections.body:
We understand that visiting a new dentist can feel uncertain. Our approach is designed to help you feel at ease from the moment you walk in.

**What makes our experience different:**

- A calm, modern, welcoming office
- A team that listens and explains everything clearly
- Gentle techniques supported by advanced technology
- A judgment-free approach to care
- Flexible scheduling

Your comfort is our priority — always.

sections.title: New patient forms
sections.body: Save time during your visit by completing your forms online. We'll send you a specific link to fill out the details we need from you prior to your appointment.

sections.title: Insurance and payment options
sections.body:
We make your first visit simple by helping you understand your benefits and providing clear, upfront information about costs.

**We offer:**

- Insurance support and benefits verification
- Flexible payment options
- Transparent pricing
- A membership plan for patients without insurance

sections.title: Meet your doctors
sections.body: Our doctors bring advanced training, modern technology, and a compassionate approach to every visit. Get to know the team who will be caring for you.

sections.title: Tour our office

membership-plan.title: A simple, affordable way to maintain your oral health
membership-plan.lede: Our membership plan is designed for patients without dental insurance — or anyone who wants predictable, transparent pricing for their preventive care. No deductibles. No claim denials. No surprises.

sections.title: Why consider a membership plan?
sections.body:
Dental care should be clear and accessible. Insurance can be confusing, unpredictable, and limiting — so we created a straightforward option that gives you the preventive care you need and savings on the treatments you choose.

With our membership plan, your oral health stays on track with stress-free, year-round benefits.

sections.title: What's included
sections.body:
Each membership provides the essentials for maintaining long-term dental health:

- Professional cleanings
- Doctor exams
- Digital x-rays as needed
- Fluoride treatments (when appropriate)
- Exclusive savings on additional treatments

Everything is bundled into one simple annual plan — no hidden fees.

sections.title: Designed to help you save
sections.body:
Our membership plan offers meaningful savings on the care you need most:

- Predictable costs for preventive care
- Discounts on restorative and cosmetic services
- No deductibles, waiting periods, or maximums
- Membership begins the day you join

It's one of the easiest ways to invest in your smile and stay on top of your oral health.

sections.title: Who is this for?
sections.body:
- Patients without dental insurance
- Families looking for affordable preventive care
- Anyone who wants transparent, predictable pricing
- Patients who prefer not to deal with insurance restrictions

If insurance has ever felt complicated or limiting, this option gives you more freedom with your care.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body:
### 1. Join the membership
Sign up at your next appointment or contact our team to enroll.

### 2. Enjoy your preventive visits
Your cleanings, exams, and x-rays are included.

### 3. Save on additional care
Receive discounted pricing on any recommended treatment.

Your membership is active for 12 months from the date you join.

sections.title: Have questions? We're here to help.
sections.body: We're happy to walk you through plan details, compare costs, or help you decide whether membership is the right fit for you or your family.

payments-and-insurance.title: Payment and insurance made simple
payments-and-insurance.lede: We believe dental care should be easy to understand and free of surprises. Whether you're using insurance, financing, or paying directly, our team is here to guide you every step of the way.

sections.title: Insurance information
sections.body:
**We help you make the most of your benefits**

Insurance can feel confusing — but we make it simple. We'll review your coverage, explain your benefits clearly, and let you know exactly what's included before treatment begins.

What we support:

- Verification of your benefits
- Clear estimates before treatment
- Help filing or processing claims
- Transparent communication about out-of-pocket costs

sections.title: We accept
sections.body:
We accept the following insurance plans:

- Aetna
- Cigna
- Delta Dental
- UnitedHealthcare
- Blue Cross Blue Shield
- PPO Provider for Guardian

Even if your plan isn't listed above, we're happy to look into your benefits and help you understand your options.

sections.title: No insurance? No problem.
sections.body:
**Our membership plan makes care predictable and affordable**

If you don't have dental insurance — or are looking for a simpler alternative — our membership plan includes preventive care and offers savings on additional treatments.

sections.title: Flexible payment options
sections.body:
**We make high-quality dentistry accessible**

We offer multiple ways to pay for your visit, making treatment as comfortable and attainable as possible.

We accept:

- Cash
- Check
- Debit
- Visa
- Mastercard
- Discover
- American Express
- Apple Pay

**CareCredit financing available**

For patients wanting to spread out the cost of treatment, we proudly offer financing through CareCredit, including short-term zero-interest options for qualifying applicants.

sections.title: Transparent estimates
sections.body:
**Know what to expect before your visit**

Before beginning any treatment, we'll provide a clear outline of:

- Recommended care
- What your insurance may cover
- Your estimated portion
- Available payment options

You'll always have the full picture — with no confusion or unexpected costs.

sections.title: Have questions about insurance or payment?
sections.body: We're here to help you feel confident and informed. Contact us anytime for guidance, explanations, or a breakdown of your benefits.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.lede: Have questions? You're not alone. Here are answers to the things patients ask us most — from appointments and technology to insurance and comfort.

sections.title: General practice
sections.body:
### Do you accept new patients?
Yes! We'd love to welcome you. You can schedule online or call/text our team.

### What should I expect at my first visit?
Your appointment includes digital imaging, a comprehensive exam, a gentle cleaning (when appropriate), and time with your doctor to review your oral health and ask questions.

### How often should I come in for cleanings?
Most patients benefit from visits every six months, though your dentist may recommend more frequent care depending on your needs.

### Do you see children?
Yes — we provide family dentistry and welcome patients of all ages.

sections.title: Comfort and technology
sections.body:
### Does laser dentistry hurt?
Most patients report little to no discomfort. Lasers allow for gentler treatment with reduced vibration and sensitivity.

### Will I need numbing for my appointment?
Often, no. With laser technology and gentle techniques, many procedures can be completed with minimal or no anesthesia.

### I'm anxious about dental visits. Can you help?
Absolutely. Our office is designed to feel calm and welcoming, and our technology allows for a gentler experience that reduces many common anxiety triggers.

### Why is laser dentistry in your name?
We are a comprehensive dental practice — laser dentistry simply reflects our elevated standard of care. It allows for more comfortable, precise treatments.

sections.title: Payment and insurance
sections.body:
### Do you take my insurance?
We work with many insurance plans and help you understand your benefits clearly. Contact us and we'll verify your coverage.

### Do you offer payment plans?
Yes — we offer flexible payment options and a membership plan for patients without insurance.

### How much will my treatment cost?
Costs vary depending on your personalized treatment plan. We provide clear estimates before any care begins so there are no surprises.

sections.title: Treatment
sections.body:
### Do you offer same-day crowns?
Yes — with CEREC technology, we can design, mill, and place a custom ceramic crown in a single visit.

### Do you place dental implants?
Yes, we offer implant placement and restoration with advanced technology and decades of combined experience.

### How long does Invisalign take?
Most patients complete treatment in 6–18 months, depending on alignment needs. You'll receive a personalized estimate at your consultation.

### Do I need x-rays at every visit?
Digital imaging is essential for accurate diagnosis. We follow safe, evidence-based guidelines to determine when x-rays are needed.

sections.title: Appointments and logistics
sections.body:
### How far in advance should I schedule?
We recommend booking routine visits 6 months ahead. For restorative or cosmetic care, availability may vary — contact us for options.

### What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
No problem — we simply ask for as much notice as possible so we can offer the time to another patient.

### Where are you located?
We're conveniently located in Franklin, TN.

sections.title: Still have questions? We're happy to help.
sections.body: Our team is here to guide you — before, during, and after your visit.
